$comment: Drop this in .claude/settings.json (project) or ~/.claude/settings.json (global). Paths assume hooks live in .claude/hooks/. Adjust if you use a different location. On Windows, point commands at the .ps1 versions or run them via 'bash'/'python'. PreToolUse entries are one line each: to enable the destructive-git guard, add this line to the PreToolUse array: { "matcher": "Bash", "hooks": [ { "type": "command", "command": "python3 .claude/hooks/guard-destructive-git.py", "timeout": 10 } ] }
